sources.title: NFL mock draft 2026: We prompted AI to predict the 1st round. Here are its picks
sources.description: We're all trying to figure out how Thursday will play out. So we asked the computers, and they had the Lions arguably getting the steal of the draft, the Seahawks getting a gift at 32, and David Bailey headed to New York ... just not the Jets.
